verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM's developer docs list several official SDKs: a Python SDK, a Node JS SDK with libraries, methods and code samples, an Android mobile SDK framework, and a Widget SDK for UI components. Together these give developers first-party client libraries to build against the CRM APIs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the SDKs work as described, and deeper evidence on SDK coverage, versioning and maintenance beyond the short doc summaries.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Build customized Python application and integrate with Zoho CRM seamlessly with this SDK.
The Node JS SDK provides the libraries, methods, and code samples that allow your node JS application to make API calls to Zoho CRM easily.
Create and integrate customized android APKs with Zoho CRM using our mobile SDK framework.
Use Zoho CRM's Widget SDK to build UI components with any open source web technology
